fields.statement: At 8f2547e4, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/ship-close-out-forget-retry.txtar dirties a tracked file in main and runs ship close-out --forget: it exits non-zero with main_updated false and update-main failed, and .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json still exists. After git checkout -- file.txt the same command reports main_updated true and the state file is gone. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-close-out-forget-retry -count=1 passes. A manual scratch repro with a fresh build gave exit=1 (update-main failed, state file kept), then exit=0 (main_updated true, state file removed). The diff in internal/api/ship_close.go moves the os.Remove of the state path to after update-main succeeds. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: fmt-check, go vet ./... and make self-check (rhiza check) all pass with RHIZA_* unset, and go test ./cmd/rhiza -count=1 passes. The only failures under heavy machine load (load average ~15 on 4 cores) were timing budgets (TestReadBudget, slice TestBudget, modelapp) and command timeouts, which report contention from other packages and do not touch this diff.
